name: Mizoram
tagline: Nature's Paradise in the North East

topAttractions.name: Reiek Hill
topAttractions.description: A scenic hill offering panoramic views of Aizawl and the surrounding landscape.

topAttractions.name: Mizo Heritage Village
topAttractions.description: A museum showcasing the traditional Mizo culture, architecture, and way of life.

topAttractions.name: Dampa Tiger Reserve
topAttractions.description: A protected area home to a variety of flora and fauna, including the Bengal tiger.

bestTimeToVisit: October to May, when the weather is mild and pleasant.
culturalFact: Mizoram is home to the traditional Mizo art of 'Hrangtial' or 'Rattan Craft', a GI-tagged craft that involves weaving and decorating rattan baskets and other items.

hiddenGem.name: Phawngpui National Park
hiddenGem.description: A lesser-known national park offering stunning views of the surrounding landscape and a chance to spot rare wildlife.

relatedFestival: The Chapchar Kut festival, a traditional Mizo harvest festival celebrated in April.
passportTieIn: If you have stamps or wishlist items for the North East region, you might already have a taste for the region's unique cuisine and culture. Mizoram is a great place to explore and experience the region's natural beauty and rich cultural heritage.
